question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing left winger, Eve is playing left back, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Finally, Fred and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) sweeper
(C) fullback
(D) left winger
(E) left back
(F) benchwarmer
(G) cheerleader
solution:
Each row lists positions in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right winger, sweeper, fullback, left winger, left back, benchwarmer, cheerleader
1. Fred ↔ Dave: right winger, sweeper, fullback, benchwarmer, left back, left winger, cheerleader
2. Bob ↔ Alice: sweeper, right winger, fullback, benchwarmer, left back, left winger, cheerleader
3. Dave ↔ Bob: sweeper, benchwarmer, fullback, right winger, left back, left winger, cheerleader
4. Alice ↔ Fred: left winger, benchwarmer, fullback, right winger, left back, sweeper, cheerleader
5. Bob ↔ Claire: left winger, fullback, benchwarmer, right winger, left back, sweeper, cheerleader
6. Eve ↔ Dave: left winger, fullback, benchwarmer, left back, right winger, sweeper, cheerleader
7. Fred ↔ Alice: sweeper, fullback, benchwarmer, left back, right winger, left winger, cheerleader
Alice is playing sweeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
